title: A Relaxing and Rewarding Wellness Month
text:
Task 1 - School Magazine Article
A Relaxing and Rewarding Wellness Month
Three Returning Highlights
This July, after the examination period, students will once again have the chance to rest and refresh themselves through Wellness Month. With the theme "Relax and Recover", this year's programme will certainly be both meaningful and enjoyable.
Firstly, the Crafting Session will return this year. Instead of focusing on South America, it will introduce arts and crafts from Asian countries, making it more relevant to students in Hong Kong. Secondly, the Wellness Fair will also be held again. Students can receive exercise advice and learn about self-care resources there. In addition, interactive booths will be added this year to make the event even more interesting. Finally, the popular Yoga and Meditation Sessions will return. Besides helping students relax, yoga can also improve focus and attention span. Moreover, two famous instructors will be invited.
What Students Said Last Year
Last year's Wellness Month was very well received. Students said that it gave them a chance to unwind after exams, helped them feel more prepared for next year's studies, and offered a wide variety of useful and meaningful activities. Some also said that they could let their creativity run loose, pick up healthy habits, and benefit from the exercise advice provided. With so many enjoyable programmes, this year's Wellness Month will certainly be worth joining.

title: Proposal on Sports Day at the Beach
text:
Task 2 - Proposal
Proposal on Sports Day at the Beach
Introduction
This proposal aims to explain why Sports Day at the Beach should be included in this year's Wellness Month and to recommend two suitable sports for the event.
Suggested Activities
Firstly, this new event would allow students to try new sports, learn about different cultures, and spend quality time outdoors. It would also be a more interesting and inclusive activity while encouraging students to become more physically active.
Secondly, it is suggested that Sepak Takraw and Kabaddi be chosen. Sepak Takraw is a sport from Southeast Asia and is similar to volleyball, although it is played without hands. It is easy for beginners to learn and also provides excellent exercise. Kabaddi, which comes from India, is also suitable because it is fun, physically challenging, and easy for newcomers to pick up. In this sport, players try to tag others while holding their breath. Both sports are likely to be new to our students and are enjoyable for beginners.
Venue
It is suggested that the event be held at Cafeteria Beach. Stanley is not suitable due to traffic problems, while parking near Cheung Sha Beach is difficult.
Conclusion
It is hoped that the above suggestions will be found useful and that this new event will be approved.

title: Letter to Parents - Wellness Month Volunteers
text:
Task 3 - Letter to Parents
Dear Parents,
You are cordially invited to serve as volunteers for this year's Wellness Month.
Firstly, parent volunteers can bring many benefits to our school events. Your involvement can help create a more positive atmosphere for students, allow them to interact with adults other than their teachers, and help them feel more relaxed during school events. In addition, last year's volunteers found the experience enjoyable and worthwhile. Many parents also had the opportunity to get to know other parents and teachers better.
Secondly, regarding the responsibilities of parent volunteers, you may be asked to assist with administrative duties, such as taking attendance, and to remain at your chosen event in case students require help. Please be assured that teachers, rather than parents, will prepare students for the activities.
Lastly, if you are interested in becoming a volunteer, we would be most grateful if you could sign up through the school app. In addition, a briefing session will be arranged before the events begin so that all volunteers can understand their duties clearly.
Should you have any enquiries, please do not hesitate to contact us. We would be more than happy to provide further information. Thank you very much for your attention, and we look forward to your support.
Yours faithfully,
Nico Lin
President, Healthy Living Club

title: 分析方法、三項任務與 Situation
text:
先掌握六類標記、三項寫作任務、身份和資料來源，再開始逐份 Data File 分析。
先定這一卷的 6 類標記：
類型1：Task 1 直接可用
= 可直接放進 校刊文章、用來宣傳 2025 Wellness Month 的資料。
類型2：Task 2 直接可用
= 可直接放進 proposal、用來爭取批准 "Sports Day at the Beach" 的資料。
類型3：Task 3 直接可用
= 可直接放進 寫給家長的信、用來招募 Wellness Month 義工的資料。
類型4：語義相關／可轉述資訊
= 不是最好直接照抄，但意思可以轉化後使用。
類型5：提示／指路／篩選線索／更新線索
= 本身未必是成品句子，但它告訴你：
● 哪頁是關鍵來源
● 哪些資料要互相比較
● 哪些舊資料已被更新
● 哪些選項雖然相關，但最後要淘汰
類型6：無關噪音／行政字樣／介面字樣／不應採用的舊資料
= 與三篇寫作無關，或版面資料，或雖然看起來相關，但最後不應寫進去。
用第 頁 定出三個任務 4 boss letter
Task 1 寫 school magazine article 去宣傳 Wellness Month。
重點：
● 只寫 2024 年曾舉辦、而且已決定會在 2025 再辦 的三個活動
● 要加入 student feedback
● 新活動 Sports Day at the Beach 不應寫進去，因為仍未獲批
Task 2 寫 proposal 爭取批准 Sports Day at the Beach。
重點：
● 為何提議這個新活動
● 選哪兩種 sport
● 這兩種 sport 的基本資料
● 為何偏偏選這兩種 sport，而不是其他
Task 3 寫 letter to parents 去招募 Wellness Month 義工。
重點：
● highlight the benefits
● explain the responsibilities
● explain how they can get involved
Situation
"You are Nico Lin. You are president of the Healthy Living Club and have been asked to help organise the Asian Games Week and Wellness Month at your school."
[你是 Nico Lin，是 Healthy Living Club 主席，並被要求協助籌辦 Asian Games Week 和 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這不是三篇作文的內容點。
● 你是學生
● 你有校內身份
● 三篇文都應以校內學生身份寫，不是老師、家長或記者身份
"You will listen to a recording of a meeting between Dr David Chan, your school's principal, Mr John Duncan, the school's vice principal, and Ms Melissa Henley, the head of PE."
[你將聆聽一段會議錄音，參與者是校長 David Chan、副校長 John Duncan 和 體育主任 Melissa Henley。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
說明錄音是正式資料來源，而且參與者都是後面文件中會反覆出現的人。 這代表錄音要和書面文件互相拼接。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
分辨 Asian Games Week 的干擾資料，以及 Wellness Month 真正可用的錄音線索。
Listening note-taking sheet
"The Asian Games Week"
[Asian Games Week]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
就這三個寫作任務來說，Asian Games Week 不是主線。 所以這整塊錄音大部分都是干擾。
"Slogan / Opening Event"
[口號／開幕活動]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
都是 Asian Games Week 內容，不是 page 4 的三題。
"The Wellness Month"
[Wellness Month]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是錄音裡真正有用的轉折位。
Task 1 和 Task 3 的關鍵補充，都會在這一段附近。
"Guest Speaker for the Asian Games Week / Speech topic / After the speech"
[Asian Games Week 嘉賓講者／演講主題／演講後]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
這些全是 Asian Games Week 的子題，對三篇作文沒用。
"Parent Involvement during the Wellness Month"
[Wellness Month 期間的家長參與]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這一格 Task 3 非常重要

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
由主管電郵鎖定三項任務、硬性要求、資料來源與錄音更新線索。
Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin（boss letter）
"To: Nico Lin / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Ballater High School Wellness Month - Things to do / Sent: April 5 2025 09:02 AM"
[收件人：Nico Lin／寄件人：John Duncan／主旨：Ballater High School Wellness Month - Things to do／時間：2025 年 4 月 5 日]
類型：5 提示
分析：
主旨已經定得很清楚： 這三個任務全部圍繞 Wellness Month。 所以錄音裡單純講 Asian Games Week 的內容應降權 Irrelevant
"Here are the tasks for you to do related to the Wellness Month."
[以下是你要處理、與 Wellness Month 有關的任務。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是整卷的總篩選句。 之後所有資料，都要看它能否服務這三個 Wellness Month 任務。
"Can you draft an article for the school magazine to promote the Wellness Month?"
[請草擬一篇校刊文章，宣傳 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定 Task 1 的文類和目的：
● 文類：school magazine article
● 目的：promote
● 讀者：學生為主
"The article should give the basic information about the three events from 2024 that we have already decided to include again."
[文章要介紹三個 2024 年的活動，而這三個已決定在 2025 再辦。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很重要，因為它定出 Task 1 的篩選原則：
● 不是所有 2024 活動都寫
● 只寫「已決定保留」的三個
"Make sure to include student feedback on the 2024 Wellness Month."
[記得加入 2024 Wellness Month 的學生意見。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是另一條硬規則：
Task 1 要用 student feedback。 所以 page 7 的學生發言最值錢；家長發言不應當成 Task 1 主體。
"You can refer to the emails between Ms Henley and I to begin with."
[可先參考我和 Ms Henley 的電郵。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接指路到第 5 頁。
"I also need you to draft a proposal about Ms Henley's idea for 'Sports Day at the Beach'."
[我還要你就 Melissa 的 'Sports Day at the Beach' 構思，草擬一份 proposal。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定出 Task 2 的文類：proposal。 這代表語氣要講理據，不是宣傳。
"This is a brand-new event that we want to include in the 2025 Wellness Month, but we need Dr Chan's approval first."
[這是一個想加入 2025 Wellness Month 的全新活動，但要先得到 Dr Chan 批 准。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句定出 Task 2 的真正功能： 不是介紹已定案活動，而是 爭取批准。 同時也解釋了為何 Task 1 不能把這個新活動寫進校刊文章。
"Make sure you explain why we are proposing this new event, which two sports we've chosen with some basic information about them, and why we included these sports."
[記得解釋為何提議這個新活動、我們選了哪兩種運動、它們的基本資料，以 及為何選它們。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句完全定出 Task 2 的資料框架：
● 提議原因
● 兩種 sport
● sport 基本資料
● 選擇理由
"I've included screenshots of a WhatsApp chat between Ms Henley and Dr Chan, which would be a good place to start."
[我附上 Melissa 和 Dr Chan 的 WhatsApp 對話截圖，那會是很好的起點。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
Task 2 首先看第 8 頁，但不會只靠第 8 頁。
"Finally, write a letter to parents to ask for volunteers for the Wellness Month."
[最後，請寫一封信給家長，邀請他們成為 Wellness Month 義工。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定出 Task 3。
"It's important that you highlight the benefits as well as outline the responsibilities they have when volunteering and how they can get involved."
[要強調好處，也要交代他們當義工的責任，以及如何參與。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句直接把 Task 3 拆成三部分：
● benefits
● responsibilities
● how to get involved
"I was discussing this over email with Mr Singh from the School Events Team this morning."
[我今天早上曾和 School Events Team 的 Mr Singh 用電郵談過這件事。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路到第 9 頁。
"I've sent you this exchange to read."
[我已把那段往來寄給你。]
類型：5 提示
"Dr Chan has asked me to give you the recording of our meeting with Ms Henley."
[Dr Chan 叫我把我和 Ms Henley 的會議錄音交給你。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
錄音是正式資料來源，不是可有可無。
"Have a listen to it: we made a few decisions about some of the above."
[你聽一聽：我們對上述一些事情作了決定。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很關鍵。 意思是：有些較早文件是舊版本，錄音有更新。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
比較 2024 舊活動與 2025 決定，找出保留、更新及淘汰的 Wellness Month 內容。
Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
"To: Ms Melissa Henley / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: RE: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 11:27 AM"
[收件人：Melissa／寄件人：John／主旨：RE: Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 11:27]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是這串電郵裡最新一封，所以衝突時應以這封為準。
"OK, I agree with you about the Fitness Challenge and Gardening & Plant Care events."
[我同意你對 Fitness Challenge 和 Gardening & Plant Care 的看法。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這句單獨看仍不知道「同意甚麼」。 要回到 Melissa 上一封才知道，她的看法是 不要再辦 這兩個活動。 所以這句不是直接答案，而是需要跨句對讀的提示。
"Sports Day at the Beach? I'm intrigued!"
[Sports Day at the Beach？我很有興趣！]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是 John 的態度反應。 不是 proposal 內容。
"Check with Dr Chan first to get his approval."
[先問 Dr Chan，取得批准。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
再次確認 Task 2 的本質是爭取批准
"It seems we now have three events that we can re-use from last year in this year's Wellness Month."
[看來我們現在已有三個去年活動，可以在今年再用。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很重要，但它只說「三個」，沒列名字。 要再結合上下文拼出是哪三個。
"I'll ask Nico to write about these in the school magazine."
[我會叫 Nico 把這些寫進校刊。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接把這組資料連到 Task 1。 但這句本身不是校刊內容。
"I think it's best not to include the new event in the promotion for now, just in case Dr Chan doesn't approve."
[我覺得目前最好不要把新活動寫進宣傳，因為 Dr Chan 可能不批准。]
類型：5 提示／篩選線索
分析：
這句非常重要。 它清楚劃線：
Task 1 article 不應寫 Sports Day at the Beach。
"To: Mr John Duncan / From: Ms Melissa Henley / Subject: RE: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 10:45 AM"
[收件人：John／寄件人：Melissa／主旨：RE: Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 10:45]
類型：5 提示
"I agree about the Crafting Session, but I would also suggest keeping the Wellness Fair."
[我同意保留 Crafting Session，同時我也建議保留 Wellness Fair。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句直接點出兩個保留活動：
● Crafting Session
● Wellness Fair
"This was pretty popular last time and seemed useful to the students."
[這活動上次很受歡迎，而且對學生有用。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是在解釋為何保留 Wellness Fair。 但它是老師判斷，不是 student feedback。 主要 所以可作保留理由，不宜當 Task 1 的 feedback。
"I plan to include interactive booths this time around to make it even more interesting."
[我打算這次加入 interactive booths，令它更有趣。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這是 Wellness Fair 的 2025 新更新。 可以直接寫進校刊文章。
"The nutritionist who usually gives the talk has already told me that she's not available, so we'll have to cancel that, but otherwise the fair will include the same great features as last year."
[通常主講營養講座的營養師已表示她沒空，所以那部分要取消；但除此以外 ，fair 仍會保留去年的其他特色。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句很關鍵，因為它告訴你：
● 去年 poster 上的 good nutrition talk 今年不應再寫
● 其他去年 fair 特色仍可保留
所以之後 page 6 poster 要「有選擇地」取用
"With regard to the Fitness Challenge and Gardening & Plant Care, let's not run these events again."
[至於 Fitness Challenge 和 Gardening & Plant Care，我們不要再辦了。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這句不是可以寫進 Task 1 的活動內容， 但它是最重要的淘汰句之一。 它直接把兩個活動剔除。
"I've come up with a completely new event that I think would be much more interesting and inclusive: Sports Day at the Beach!"
[我想出一個全新活動，我覺得它會更有趣、更具包容性： Sports Day at the Beach！]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句可以直接用作 proposal 的理由之一：
● more interesting
● more inclusive
"To: Ms Melissa Henley / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 10:12 AM"
[收件人：Melissa／寄件人：John／主旨：Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 10:12]
類型：5 提示
"Let's decide on what the other events in the 2025 Wellness Month will be. Dr Chan already helped us choose one event in our meeting last week."
[讓我們決定 2025 Wellness Month 其餘活動。Dr Chan 上週會議已幫我們選定 其中一個活動。]
類型：5 提示
分析 - 這句說明：
● 在這串 email 開始之前，已經有 一個活動先被選定
● 這個活動最合理就是之後錄音 Podcast確認會再辦的
Yoga & Meditation Sessions
[ Dr Chan already helped us choose one event in our meeting last week."] 但這句本身沒有明講活動名稱，所以它是提示，不是直接答案。
"I've attached the poster we used for last year's Wellness Month, as a reminder of the events we held last time."
[我附上去年的 Wellness Month 海報，提醒我們去年有哪些活動。]
類型：5 提示
分析： 指路到第 6 頁。 也再一次提醒：poster 是 舊資料。
"I recommend having the Fitness Challenge again."
[我建議再辦 Fitness Challenge。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這是較早版本的建議。 後來 Melissa 明確反對，而 John 也接受她的看法。 所以這句最後 不能採用。
"I also liked the Crafting Session, but this year, let's switch to Asian countries to make it more relevant to our students in Hong Kong."
[我也喜歡 Crafting Session，但今年改成以亞洲國家為主，更切合香港學生]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句很值錢，因為它同時做了兩件事：
● 確認 Crafting Session 保留
● 更新舊 poster 的 South America 為 Asian countries
"What are your thoughts?"
[你怎樣看？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是詢問，不是內容點。

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024
text:
逐項審視舊海報，只保留已獲 2025 文件或錄音確認的活動與特色。
Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024
"Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024"
[附件：2024 Wellness Month 海報]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句已經提醒你： 整頁是 舊版資料庫，只能與 2025 決定互相比對後再用。
"Wellness Month 2024"
[2024 Wellness Month]
類型：5 提示
分析：
年份本身就提示：這不是可直接照搬到 2025 的成品。
"Theme: The wonders of South America"
[主題：南美洲奇觀] 過時線索
類型：5 提示／
分析：
不能 這句 寫進 2025 article。 因為 2025 的主題在錄音裡已改成 Relax and Recover。 而 Crafting Session 的地區內容也改成亞洲。
"Crafting Session"
[手作活動]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這個活動本身被保留。
"Arts and crafts from South American countries"
[來自南美洲國家的藝術與手作]
類型：5 提示／過時線索
分析：
「Crafting Session」保留了， 但「South American countries」已被 page 5 更新為 Asian countries。 所以這一句本身不能直接用，只能提醒你要更新。
"Get creative!"
[發揮創意！]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這句不是核心資訊，但「creativity」這個意思仍可轉述。 而且 page 7 Alex 也說自己很喜歡讓創意自由發揮，兩邊互相呼應。
"Gardening & Plant Care"
[園藝與植物護理]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這是去年舊活動，但 page 5 已決定不再辦。 所以它的作用主要是提醒你： 這是候選舊活動，但已被淘汰。
"Get hands-on with gardening"
[親手做園藝]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
活動已被淘汰，所以細節也不應寫入 Task 1。
"Unique plants from South America"
[來自南美洲的獨特植物]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
同上
"Yoga & Meditation Sessions"
[瑜伽與冥想環節]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這個活動在錄音Podcast 裡被確認保留，而且還有新宣傳角度。
"Join us for a special surprise..."
[來參加，迎接一個特別驚喜……]
類型：5 提示／過時線索
分析：
這是 2024 舊海報上的模糊宣傳語。 2025 不應再用這種空泛寫法，因為錄音已提供更具體的新賣點：
● improve focus and attention span
● two famous instructors
"Wellness Fair"
[健康博覽]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這個活動被保留。
"Talk on good nutrition"
[關於良好營養的講座]
類型：5 提示／不應直接採用
分析：
這一點去年有，但 page 5 已說今年營養師沒空，所以這部分要取消。 因此不能直接搬進 2025 article。
"Exercise advice"
[運動建議]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
因為 page 5 已說 fair 會保留去年其他特色， 而 page 7 Maya 也提到自己聽到了關於做運動的建議， 所以這一項可以保留。
"Self-care resources"
[自我照顧資源]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
同上，仍屬保留內容。
"Fitness Challenge"
[體能挑戰]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
John 曾建議保留，但 Melissa 反對，John 最後接受反對。 所以它是舊候選，最後不應採用。
"Wide range of fitness activities / Compete against each other / Stay fit!"
[多種體能活動／彼此競賽／保持健康！]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
因為整個活動已淘汰，所以這些細節不能進 Task 1。

title: Transcript of an interview during the 2024 Wellness Month
text:
抽取 Task 1 所需的學生意見，以及 Task 3 可用的家長義工經驗。
Transcript of an interview during the 2024 Wellness Month
"Transcript of an interview by a Campus TV reporter during the 2024 Wellness Month"
[2024 Wellness Month 期間校園電視記者訪問逐字稿]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這頁最重要的功能是提供 feedback。 但要記住 page 4 要求的是 student feedback，不是家長 feedback。
"Excuse me, we are part of the Campus TV channel doing a report on the Wellness Month. Here we are on the last day. Would you mind if I asked you guys a few questions about your experience this past month?"
[我們是 Campus TV，想訪問你們過去這一個月的體驗。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是訪問背景，不是實質內容點。
"Sure, sure. Go ahead."
[好呀，請吧。]
類型：6 無關噪音
"Great! Can I ask your names first?"
[可以先問你們的名字嗎？]
類型：6 無關噪音
"Sure. We're Alex and Emma, both in Form 5, and my dad's over there - he's been helping out."
[我們是 Alex 和 Emma，爸爸也在那邊幫忙。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句不是 Task 1 的 student feedback 主體， 但它先提示你：這頁同時有 家長義工 這條線。 因此對 Task 3 有指路作用。
"I'm Maya and I'm in Form 2. This is my mum. She's also been helping."
[我是 Maya，我媽媽也有幫忙。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
同上，顯示家長義工確實存在。
"Perfect! So, how has the Wellness Month been for you all?"
[那 Wellness Month 對你們來說怎樣？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
下面開始會出現真正的 feedback。
"Brilliant! I've loved it. I really struggled during the exams, especially my electives.
The Wellness Month was a chance to unwind. I feel much more prepared for next year's studies now!"
[太棒了，我很喜歡。我考試時很辛苦，尤其選修科。Wellness Month 讓我有機 會放鬆，我覺得自己對明年學習更有準備。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這是非常強的 student feedback。 而且它和錄音後來定下的 2025 主題 Relax and Recover 完全扣上 它能支持你在 Task 1 寫：
● 活動幫學生在考試後放鬆
● 幫學生重新整理狀態，準備下一年
"I totally agree. I was really impressed by the wide variety of activities. Meaningful activities, I mean. Everything was useful."
[我完全同意。我很欣賞活動種類很多，而且都很有意思，一切都很有用。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句可用來支持整個 Wellness Month 的整體宣傳：
● wide variety
● meaningful
● useful
"How about you, Maya? Maya's mum?"
[你們呢？]
類型：5 提示
"I've been a helper at some of the events, and it was great to see so many parents take up this role.
What really surprised me was how much fun it was for us parents too. Everyone I talked to had a great time!"
[我曾在一些活動中做幫手，看到很多家長參與真的很好。最令我驚喜的是， 家長自己也玩得很開心。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這不是 Task 1，因為 page 4 指明要 student feedback。 但對 Task 3 很有用，因為它直接提供家長義工的好處：
● 很多家長都願意參與
● 家長自己也會覺得很有趣
● 整體感受很好
"Did you guys have fun at the events too?"
[你們玩得開心嗎？]
類型：5 提示
"For sure. For me, I loved the chance to let my creativity run loose. I also picked up quite a few healthy habits as well."
[當然。我很喜歡可以自由發揮創意，也學到不少健康習慣。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句很有用，因為它可以分別連到兩條線：
● creativity → Crafting Session
● healthy habits → Wellness Month 整體目標 / Wellness Fair
"Yes, some of the Form 6 students gave a talk about doing exercise. I don't do enough exercise, so I really needed to hear their advice!"
[有呀，當時有一些中六學生講做運動。我平時運動不夠，所以我真的很需要 那些建議。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句對 Wellness Fair 很有幫助。 因為 poster 上有 Exercise advice，而這句正好證明學生覺得那部分有用。 雖然講者細節未必要保留， 但「exercise advice 幫到學生」是可以直接寫進 Task 1 的。
"How has it been for you, Alex's dad?"
[對你來說怎樣？]
類型：5 提示
"I was helping out at the fitness challenge event. I actually took some time off work to take part, but it was worth it."
[我在 Fitness Challenge 幫忙。我還特地請了些假來參與，但很值得。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用（部分）
分析：
這句有兩層：
● "Fitness Challenge" 這個活動本身今年不再辦，所以不能照抄活動名稱
● 但 "it was worth it" 是很好的家長義工 benefit
所以可用的重點是：做義工很值得。
"So it seems your dad had as much fun as you did, Alex?"
[看來你爸爸也玩得很開心？]
類型：5 提示
"Haha, yes! Some of my friends' parents are here helping out too, and dad seems to have got to know so many of them."
[是呀，我一些朋友的家長也有幫忙，爸爸好像因此認識了很多人。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句很值錢，因為它提供另一個家長義工 benefit： 可以認識其他家長。
"And the teachers! I really enjoyed that aspect of volunteering."
[還有老師！我很享受義工工作中的這一部分。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
補足上句： 家長做義工不只認識其他家長，也會認識老師。 這對招募信很有說服力。
"Sounds like fun all around. Thanks all! Enjoy the rest of the day!"
[聽起來大家都很開心。謝謝！]
類型：6 無關噪音

title: WhatsApp chat between Ms Melissa Henley and Dr David Chan
text:
整理 Sports Day at the Beach 的目的、選擇標準、場地考慮及批准條件。
WhatsApp chat between Ms Melissa Henley and Dr David Chan
"Hi Dr Chan. Quick question about the Wellness Month. We'd like to add a new event called Sports Day at the Beach. What do you think?"
[我們想加一個新活動，叫 Sports Day at the Beach。你覺得如何？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句定出 page 8 的主線：Task 2。 但它只是引子，不是 proposal 內容本身。
"Oh wow. That sounds interesting. So, what would this new event entail?"
[聽起來很有趣。那這個活動具體是甚麼？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
下面開始會出現 Task 2 的核心理由。
"It's basically a mini sports day, on the beach, with two sports our students are likely to have never played before."
[基本上是一個在海灘舉行的小型運動日，裡面有兩種學生很可能從未玩過 的運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句直接給出新活動的核心設計：
● mini sports day
● on the beach
● two sports
● students probably have never played them before
"One of the aims would be to expose them to different cultures."
[其中一個目的，是讓學生接觸不同文化。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這是 proposal 的明確理由之一
"Sounds like a good way to get our students to try new sports. Why on the beach?"
[聽起來是讓學生嘗試新運動的好方法。為何要在海灘？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
前半是正面回應，後半是引出另一個 proposal 理由。
"We thought it'd be a chance for them to spend some quality time outdoors."
[我們覺得這會讓學生有機會在戶外享受優質時光。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這是 proposal 的另一個理由：
● quality time outdoors
"A trip to the beach would be fun for the students. Which sports are you thinking of including?"
[去海灘對學生來說應該會很好玩。你們想加入哪兩種運動？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
前半可作支持語氣，後半是引出 sport 篩選條件
"We're still looking at that. We definitely need sports that the students haven't tried before."
[我們還在看。不過一定要選學生沒試過的運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這是第一個明確的選 sport 標準。
"And they need to be physically challenging - the whole point is to get the students moving."
[而且它們要有身體挑戰性，因為重點是要令學生動起來。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這是第二個明確標準。 之後 page 11 會用這條去淘汰 Go
"Agree, but remember that this will be their first time trying the sports."
[同意，但記住這會是他們第一次玩。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句引出第三個篩選標準：新手友善。
"The sports need to be enjoyable for beginners. Remember the lacrosse trials?"
[這些運動要令初學者也覺得好玩。你還記得 lacrosse trials 嗎？]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（前半） + 5 提示（後半）
分析：
真正有用的是前半：
● enjoyable for beginners
後半 "Remember the lacrosse trials?" 只是負面經驗提示，用來加強為何要照 顧 beginners，不是 proposal 內容。
"Don't remind me - never again!"
[不要再提了，永遠不要。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
只是對過去失敗經驗的反應。
"Where do you suggest having the event?"
[你建議在哪個海灘舉辦？]
類型：5 提示
"John and I were talking about Stanley Main Beach, Cafeteria Beach or Cheung Sha Beach."
[John 和我想過 Stanley Main Beach、Cafeteria Beach 或 Cheung Sha Beach。]
類型：5 提示／篩選線索
分析：
這句不是 final venue。 只是提供三個候選地點。 (要到 page 9 再淘汰兩個)
"It depends on the transport situation, especially if we're taking the whole school."
[要視乎交通安排，尤其如果是全校一起去。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句很重要，因為它說明地點選擇的核心標準是 transport。 所以之後 School Events Team 和巴士公司的意見會變得很重要。
"Ask Manraj in the School Events Team. He has a lot of experience with this."
[問 School Events Team 的 Manraj 吧，他很有經驗。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路 到第 9 頁
"John's already in touch with Manraj about this. I'll get him to ask."
[John 已經就這件事和 Manraj 聯絡，我會叫他去問。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路 繼續 到第 9 頁。
"So, do you like our new event?"
[那你喜歡我們這個新活動嗎？]
類型：5 提示
"It sounds promising, but I'll have to see the full proposal before I can approve."
[聽起來很有希望，但我仍要先看完整 proposal 才能批准。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
再次說明 Task 2 的功能是 說服批准。
"Sure. John will ask Nico to work on this. We should have something for you to look at soon."
[好的。John 會叫 Nico 處理，我們很快會給你看。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
說明 Nico 就是 proposal 的寫作者
"I look forward to reading it!"
[期待拜讀！]
類型：6 無關噪音

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Mr Manraj Singh
text:
找出家長義工的實際職責、參與方法，以及海灘交通和場地篩選資料。
Emails between Mr John Duncan and Mr Manraj Singh
"To: Mr Manraj Singh / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: RE: Wellness Month / Sent: April 5 2025 8:05 AM"
[收件人：Manraj／寄件人：John／主旨：RE: Wellness Month／時間：4 月 5 日 8:05]
類型：5 提示
分析：
最新一封，優先度較高。
"Ah yes, I remember the parents administering some of the events - taking attendance and so on."
[對了，我記得家長曾負責一些行政工作，例如點名之類。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句直接提供家長義工職責：
● administration
● taking attendance
"I'll see what I can do in regards to getting a few more parent volunteers this year."
[我會看看可以如何多找幾位家長義工。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是內部行動，不是信中要寫的正文點
"To: Mr John Duncan / From: Mr Manraj Singh / Subject: RE: Wellness Month / Sent: April 5 2025 8:00 AM"
[收件人：John／寄件人：Manraj／主旨：RE: Wellness Month／時間：4 月 5 日 8:00]
類型：5 提示
"So, it was the teachers who got the students ready for the events."
[其實是老師負責幫學生為活動作準備。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句非常重要，因為它是 更正句。 John 之前以為家長會幫學生準備活動，但 Manraj 說不是 所以 Task 3 一定不能寫錯成「家長會負責訓練或準備學生」 真正負責準備的是老師。
"The parents who were 'hanging around' had just been told to be present at their chosen event, basically, in case students needed help with anything."
[那些看似在場等待的家長，其實只是被安排在自己選擇的活動現場，萬一學 生需要幫忙時就可協助。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句直接提供義工責任：
● be present at their chosen event
● help students if needed
Parents also played an important administration role throughout the month, so if you could get us some volunteers, that would be helpful."
[家長在整個月裡也扮演重要行政角色，所以如果你能替我們找一些義工就 太好了。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
再一次確認家長義工不是主要教學角色，而是行政支援角色。
"I've attached a blog post I found online with some more information which may help persuade parents to join as volunteers."
[我附上一篇網上 blog，裡面有更多資料，或許能幫助說服家長加入做義工。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路到 page 10 blog。 也說明 blog 的功能：幫助說服家長。
"Take a look. Maybe Nico can use this to write the letter you mentioned."
[看看吧，也許 Nico 可以用它來寫你提到的那封信。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接把 blog 連到 Task 3。
"The school bus company said that the traffic in Stanley means this shouldn't be an option."
[校巴公司說，Stanley 的交通情況代表這個地點不應考慮。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句直接淘汰 Stanley Main Beach。 所以 page 8 的候選地點由 3 個減至 2 個。
"They also said that parking near Cheung Sha Beach is difficult, so I think this only leaves you with one option (they said that one would be fine)."
[他們也說 Cheung Sha Beach 附近泊車困難，所以我想只剩下一個選項了，而 那個選項是可行的。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句再淘汰 Cheung Sha Beach。 回頭對 page 8 三個候選地點：
● Stanley Main Beach ❌
● Cheung Sha Beach ❌
● 剩下 Cafeteria Beach ✅
所以雖然這句沒有直接說出名字，但經過跨頁推理，唯一可用地點就是 Cafeteria Beach
"To: Mr Manraj Singh / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Wellness Month / Sent: April 3 2025 2:05 PM"
[收件人：Manraj／寄件人：John／主旨：Wellness Month／時間：4 月 3 日 2:05]
類型：5 提示
"I'm trying to find out about how parents got involved in the Wellness Month last year."
[我想知道去年家長如何參與 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句說明 page 9 的主題會是 Task 3。
"I think I remember parents helping students prepare for the events? Is that right?"
[我好像記得家長有幫學生為活動作準備？是嗎？]
類型：5 提示／錯誤線索
分析：
這句不是最終答案。 它甚至是 錯的初步記憶。 後面 Manraj 會更正：準備學生的是老師，不是家長。
"I also remember quite a number of parents hanging around the events. Did they have a specific role?"
[我也記得有不少家長在活動場地附近。他們是否有特定角色？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是好問題，但答案要看 Manraj 的回覆。
"Also, I'd be grateful for that information from the school bus company we discussed in the staff room."
[另外，也想請你給我那份校巴公司資料。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句把地點選擇和交通問題連到 Task 2。

title: Email attachment - 'The Influator' blog
text:
把家長參與研究轉化為 Task 3 可用的好處，同時避開只屬作者個人意見的內容。
Email attachment - 'The Influator' blog
"Andy Law is 'The Influator' (educator turned influencer)"
[Andy Law 就是 'The Influator'（由教育工作者轉型成 influencer）]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是作者身份。 不是信件核心內容，但說明這是意見／分析文章，不是校方官方文件。
"2nd November 2024"
[2024 年 11 月 2 日]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是外部資料日期。 不是最終信件內容，但可以知道它是較早的背景材料。
"Time to update you on an interesting study I found recently. Take a look at this chart:"
[我最近看到一個有趣研究，來看看這張圖。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是引入研究。
"School performance over time"
[學校表現隨時間變化]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這是圖表標題。 它不是家長招募信要直接寫的句子， 但表示 parental support 和學校表現有正面關係 Positive Relationship
"Introduction of Parental Support Policy in School"
[學校引入家長支援政策]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
圖上的關鍵節點。 可作背景理解：家長參與是有正面效果的。
"The chart really speaks for itself in terms of the profound impact of parents being involved in their child's school life."
[這張圖很清楚顯示家長參與孩子校園生活的深遠影響。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這句不太像學校 letter 會直接寫出的語氣， 但它提供可轉述的總結： 家長參與有正面影響。
"We know that parental support at home, such as helping students with their homework and revision, has always been part of this, but finally this gives us solid evidence about parents being more involved at school."
[我們一直知道家長在家中支援學習有幫助，而這研究更提供證據，說明家長 在學校更積極參與同樣有益。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這句的重點是「at school 的參與也有價值」 可作 Task 3 的支持概念，但不宜原句照搬。
"The study states that a big benefit is the atmosphere it creates for students."
[研究指出，一大好處是它能為學生創造更好的氣氛。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這是很實用的家長義工 benefit。 信中可寫成：家長參與能創造正面、支持性的校園活動氣氛。
"At school, students only get one type of adult interaction: with their teachers."
[在學校裡，學生通常只接觸一種成人：老師。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這是論證的一部分。 可幫你寫出：家長參與能令學生接觸更多不同成人榜樣 + 引出下面 Benefit
"When you get parents in the mix at school, students then get to interact with other adults."
[當家長加入校園活動，學生就有機會和其他成年人互動。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句可直接轉化為 Task 3 的 benefit
"The atmosphere created makes students feel more relaxed during school events."
[這種氣氛令學生在學校活動中感到更放鬆。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句很有用，因為：
● 它是對學生的好處
● 又和 2025 Wellness Month 的 "Relax and Recover" 氣氛很吻合
"We know what that means for students: less depression and, naturally, less anxiety."
[這代表學生會較少抑鬱，也較少焦慮。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
意思可理解，但原句太重、太醫療化。 寫給家長的招募信通常不會用這麼重的字眼。 所以最好只轉述成上面的「help students feel more relaxed / supported」。
"One thing's for sure: when my kids are older, I'll be at that school as much as I can, helping out in any way I can!"
[有一件事我很肯定：等我孩子大一點，我一定會盡量在學校幫忙。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
這是 blog 作者的個人態度。 可以提供熱心參與的語氣，但不是核心內容點。
"Thanks for reading, guys! Leave a comment below and share with your friends."
[謝謝收看，歡迎留言分享。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
純 blog 收尾。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Ms Melissa Henley
text:
把運動文章連回 Task 2，並鎖定選擇或淘汰個別運動的線索。
Email from Mr John Duncan to Ms Melissa Henley
"To: Ms Melissa Henley / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Sports for the Beach / Sent: March 27 2025 4:22 PM"
[收件人：Melissa／寄件人：John／主旨：海灘運動／時間：3 月 27 日 4:22]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這封 email 的功能是把 page 11 article 接上 Task 2。
"Here's an article about some sports that might be suitable for Sports Day at the Beach."
[這裡有一篇關於一些可能適合 Sports Day at the Beach 的運動的文章。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路 到第 11 頁。
"First out of the gate, I'm sure Dr Chan wouldn't approve anything that involves our students going in or out on the water."
[先說第一點，我很肯定 Dr Chan 不會批准任何要學生進出水中的活動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這是極重要的淘汰標準 它直接排除 water sports
"I think you know which one we definitely can't do, then!"
[你應該知道哪一項我們肯定不能做了吧！]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這不是 final 答案句， 但它明確指向要淘汰 Dragon Boat Racing
"Their expert is spot on about Jianzi: I see students in the playground playing this nearly every day."
[那位專家對 Jianzi 的說法很對：我幾乎每天都見到學生在操場玩這項運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句直接推翻了 Jianzi 的「新鮮感」條件 因為 page 8 要求選學生沒試過的 sport。 既然校內學生幾乎天天玩，Jianzi 就不合格。
"Not sure how new this will be to them."
[我不覺得這對他們來說有多新。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句把淘汰 Jianzi 的結論講得更清楚
"I've attached the article to this email. Have a read through it when you have time."
[我已附上文章，有空看看。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
再次指路到第 11 頁

title: Email attachment - a magazine article on sports
text:
比較各項運動是否新鮮、容易入門、具文化特色及足夠活躍。
Email attachment - a magazine article on sports
"Email attachment - a magazine article on sports"
[附件：一篇關於運動的雜誌文章]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這整頁的功能是給 Task 2 篩 sport，不是整篇照抄。
"Your New Favourite Sport?"
[你新的最愛運動？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是文章標題。
"What are the new up-and-coming sports to try this summer? We asked Laura Mak, a leading sports expert."
[今個夏天有哪些新興運動值得一試？我們訪問了運動專家 Laura Mak。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是文章引入。 真正有價值的是後面各項運動的特性。
"Sepak Takraw: type of volleyball played with feet, head, chest and knees (no hands)."
[Sepak Takraw：一種類似排球的運動，但用腳、頭、胸和膝蓋，不用手。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句提供 Sepak Takraw 的基本資料，正符合 page 4 對 proposal 的要求。
"Sepak Takraw has really been gaining popularity recently."
[Sepak Takraw 近來很受歡迎。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
可作 sport 的吸引點。
"It's just about to break out of its home of Southeast Asia."
[它正準備從東南亞走向更廣地方。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句很適合 page 8 的「expose students to different cultures」 因為它本身就帶有亞洲文化背景。
"It isn't that hard to learn - newcomers should find it easy to pick up."
[它不算難學，新手應該容易上手。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這一點完全符合 page 8 的 beginners 條件。
"It's great exercise, too."
[而且它也很能運動身體。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這一點又符合 page 8 的 physically challenging / get students moving。 所以 Sepak Takraw 幾乎完美符合全部條件。
"Wushu is a sport that we can see all around Hong Kong, but it takes a few years of dedicated training to really learn the basics."
[Wushu 在香港隨處可見，但要真正掌握基本功，往往要訓練幾年。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
這句給了兩個淘汰理由：
● 在香港已很常見，不夠新
● 要幾年才能學好，對 beginners 不友善
"Another sport to try, if you haven't already, is Jianzi, a traditional Chinese sport many people play in their free time."
[另一種運動是 Jianzi，一種很多人平日會玩的中國傳統運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
這句本身已經在削弱 Jianzi 的「新鮮」條件， 再加上 page 10 John 說學生幾乎天天玩，就更明顯要淘汰。
"It's a kind of juggling game."
[它是一種類似拋接的遊戲。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這只是解釋 Jianzi 是甚麼。 但由於 Jianzi 已被淘汰，這句不再重要。
"You might well have seen it before. Just about every school student here in Hong Kong has played this at some point."
[你很可能以前已見過。香港幾乎每個學生都玩過。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
這句幾乎是淘汰 Jianzi 的鐵證。 它直接違反 page 8 的「students haven't tried before」。
"Go: board game involving critical thinking and patience. Easy to play but difficult to master, Go has roots in Ancient China."
[圍棋：一種講求思考和耐性的棋盤遊戲，容易玩，但難精通，源自中國古代。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
它有文化味，但 page 8 的重點是 get students moving。 圍棋明顯不符這一條。
"It's not the most active of pursuits, as players can be sat down for a very long time."
[它並不是很活躍的活動，因為玩家會坐很久。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
這句直接和 page 8 的 physically challenging 相衝突。 所以 Go 應淘汰
"the game itself is very easy to learn."
[這個遊戲本身很容易學。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
雖然這點符合 beginners， 但因為它不夠 active，所以仍不能入選。 這是 DSE 常見情況：不是單一條件合格就可入選，要整體對題。
"I know a lot of people who play this game."
[我認識很多人玩這遊戲。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
又再削弱「新鮮感」。
"Kabaddi, from India, is actually a really fun sport to play."
[Kabaddi 來自印度，其實是一種很好玩的運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句非常符合 page 8 的文化目標：
● from India
● expose students to different cultures
"I know so many friends who play this now and it's certainly designed to keep players on the move."
[我有很多朋友現在也玩這項運動，而它明顯是設計來讓玩家不停移動的。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句完全符合 page 8 的 get students moving。
"Beginners can pick this sport up quickly, which might account for its growing popularity."
[初學者可以很快上手，這也許解釋了它為何愈來愈受歡迎。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句又完全符合 page 8 的 beginners 條件。 所以 Kabaddi 和 Sepak Takraw 一樣，非常吻合。
"It's similar to the game Tag, isn't it?"
[它跟捉人遊戲有點似，是嗎？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句引出較易明白的比較方式。
"Some elements, yes. In Kabaddi, players try to tag others, that's true, but they do so while holding their breath."
[有些元素相似。Kabaddi 也是要碰到別人，但同時要閉氣。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句提供 Kabaddi 的基本玩法資訊，可直接放進 proposal。
"I've played this sport a few times and I'm a big fan."
[我玩過幾次，我很喜歡。]
類型：4 語義相關
分析：
是專家的正面評價，可轉化成推薦語氣，但不必直抄。
"Dragon Boat Racing is a sport that some of us might be familiar with."
[龍舟是我們其中一些人可能熟悉的運動。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
它一開始就不太符合「新鮮感」。
"I've been Dragon Boat Racing at Stanley Main Beach and it was a lot of fun and a great workout."
[我曾在 Stanley Main Beach 划龍舟，那很有趣而且很能鍛煉身體。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
雖然它符合運動量，但 page 10 已說 任何會進出水的活動 Dr Chan 都不會批 准。 所以即使有吸引點，也要淘汰。
"if you're daring enough to enter the water, you're pretty sure to make friends for life with your teammates."
[如果你敢下水，你很可能會和隊友成為長久朋友。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
"enter the water" 這四個字正正是淘汰原因。
"It's pretty tiring, though, and the training schedule can be demanding."
[不過它頗累，而且訓練時間表也可能很吃力。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
這句再加一層淘汰理由： 對 beginners 可能太 demanding。
"Dragon Boat Racing: popular water sport where teams race each other using ornate, elongated boats."
[龍舟：一項受歡迎的水上運動，隊伍乘長船比賽。]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用（淘汰線索）
分析：
box 定義本身已足夠證明：這是 water sport，所以不能選。

title: PODCAST Recording Transcript
text:
利用較新的錄音決定覆蓋舊資料，確認主題、活動賣點、義工安排與報名方法。
PODCAST Recording Transcript
"Hello John, Melissa. Good to see you both today. / Hello Dr Chan. / Hello Dr Chan. Good to see you."
[大家問好。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
只是開場寒暄。
"As you know, the purpose of this meeting is to discuss the preparations for the Asian Games Week in October and the Wellness Month in July."
[這次會議是討論 10 月 Asian Games Week 和 7 月 Wellness Month 的準備。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句有兩個作用：
● 再次提醒錄音有兩條線
● 同時補到一個時間資訊：Wellness Month 在 July
但就三題來說，最重要的功能仍是提醒你要把錄音分線閱讀。
"John, have we decided on a slogan for the Asian Games Week yet? / Not yet ... / How about... Passion, Pride, Performance? / ... use the official slogan ... / It's One Games, One Asia. / ... there's a comma ... / It'll look very good on the poster."
[討論 Asian Games Week 口號：One Games, One Asia。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
這一整段都是 Asian Games Week，不屬三個寫作任務。
Asian Games Week opening event
"OK, so we're going with One Games, One Asia then? / Absolutely."
[決定採用 One Games, One Asia。]
類型：6 無關噪音
"have we decided on a date yet? / ... the 6th or the 13th of October ... / isn't the 7th a public holiday? / ... Let's start ... on the 13th of October"
[討論 Asian Games Week 開始日期，最後定 10 月 13 日。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
仍然是 Asian Games Week，與三題無關。
"Melissa, you were thinking of inviting someone to come speak at the school ... / ... it can be just an afternoon. / Is the event indoors or outdoors? / ... sports ground."
[討論 Asian Games Week 開幕嘉賓與場地。]
類型：6 無關噪音
Wellness Month
"To be safe, though, we'd better hold it in the Main Hall. We never know what the skies will bring. / I agree ..."
[討論 Asian Games Week 場地，改在 Main Hall。]
類型：6 無關噪音
"We're holding some of the events of the Wellness Month in the Main Hall as well, aren't we?"
[Wellness Month 有些活動也會在 Main Hall。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句不是三題核心內容。 但它是對話轉向 Wellness Month 的過渡句。
"That's right, but the Wellness Month starts in July. It won't affect the Asian Games Week in October."
[沒錯，不過 Wellness Month 在 7 月開始，不會影響 10 月的 Asian Games Week]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句有一個可用背景：Wellness Month 在 July。 但對三篇文來說，主要作用仍是轉場。
"Speaking of the Wellness Month, what theme are we using this year?"
[說到 Wellness Month，今年主題是甚麼？]
類型：5 提示
"I was actually thinking of using the theme of hiking for this year's Wellness Month since we haven't done that theme yet."
[我原本想用 hiking 作為今年主題。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這是候選主題，但不是最後決定。 要看後面如何被否決。
"Hiking? In July? ... I think it's much too hot for hiking then."
[7 月去行山太熱。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這句是淘汰 hiking theme 的理由。
"The Wellness Month is just after the students finish their exams. How about ... Relax and Recover?"
[Wellness Month 正在考試後，不如用 Relax and Recover？]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句同時提供：
● 主題背景：考試後
● 2025 主題：Relax and Recover
這是 Task 1 非常核心的資料。
"Do the students really need to 'recover' after their exams? The teachers, maybe."
[學生真的需要 recover 嗎？老師可能更需要。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
只是玩笑／輕微質疑，後面並沒有推翻主題。
"Relax and Recover fits in well with this part of the school year. Let's go with that."
[Relax and Recover 很適合這個學年階段，就用它吧。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句把主題正式定案
"I remember that last year's Yoga and Meditation sessions were a big hit with students. We should run these again this year."
[我記得去年的 Yoga and Meditation 很受學生歡迎，我們今年應再辦。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句明確確認第三個保留活動就是 Yoga & Meditation Sessions。
"Yes, we should, and they fit the theme as well."
[對，應該再辦，而且它們也很配合主題。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句把 Yoga 與 Relax and Recover 直接扣上。
"Perhaps we can focus on another benefit of Yoga this time, though, when we do the promotion."
[不過今年宣傳時，我們或許可以改為強調 Yoga 的另一個好處。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很重要，但它本身未講答案。 它是明顯的「路標句」： 下一頁會補出應強調的 benefit。
Yoga 更新 + 後段又回到 Asian Games
"Which benefit is that?"
[是哪個好處？]
類型：5 提示
"What most people don't know is that Yoga can improve your focus and attention span."
[很多人不知道，Yoga 可以改善專注力和注意力持續時間。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這是 2025 Yoga 宣傳的最新賣點。 比起 page 6 那句 "special surprise"，這句具體得多，應直接採用。
"That's a great selling point. I know plenty of students who struggle with this, so if this event can help them out with that, all the better."
[這是一個很好的賣點，很多學生都會有這個問題。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
應直接採用
"Excellent. Mention this benefit when we promote the Yoga and Meditation sessions."
[很好，宣傳 Yoga and Meditation 時要提這個好處。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句幾乎等於直接命令你：
Task 1 一定要提 Yoga 對專注力的幫助。
"I also remember that the event was so popular last year because of the celebrity Yoga instructors. Having not one, but two famous instructors was a huge hit!"
[我也記得這活動去年那麼受歡迎，是因為有名人瑜伽導師，而且不是一位， 是兩位。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句提供另一個吸引點：
● two famous instructors
● 去年很受歡迎
"Melissa, could you invite them again this year? / I can ... we can't use their names just yet until they've confirmed. I can get two famous instructors for sure, though. / Put that in the marketing as well."
[請再次邀請他們；名字暫時未能公開，但可確定會有兩位 유명導師；這也要 放進宣傳。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這組句子告訴你：
● 可以宣傳 two famous instructors
● 但 不可寫名字，因為未 confirmed
這是很典型的 DSE 細節位： 要寫「有兩位知名導師」，但不能自己亂補姓名。
"Ah, speaking of invitations ... guest speaker ... interesting sport ... added to the Asian Games ... survey ..."
[之後又回到 Asian Games Week 嘉賓講者與調查。]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
這一整段又回去 Asian Games Week，對三題無用。
"How can we make the event more interactive? / holding a discussion after the speech / students ask questions..."
[討論 Asian Games Week 如何更互動。]
類型：6 無關噪音
"OK, back to the Wellness Month. There are a few more things we need to talk about."
[好，回到 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句表示錄音真正有用的部分又開始了。
"We're definitely going to need some help once the Wellness Month begins. ... last year we had some parents involved, is that right?"
[Wellness Month 開始後一定需要幫手；去年也有家長參與，對嗎？]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句把對話直接轉到 Task 3。
"Er, yes, that's right, though I don't quite remember exactly what their responsibilities were."
[有是有，但我不太記得他們的確切責任。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
提醒你：實際責任要到 page 9 找。
"I'll get in touch with Mr Singh on the Events Team to check our records and see what responsibilities the parents had."
[我會聯絡 Events Team 的 Mr Singh，查記錄看看家長責任。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接指路到 page 9。
"I remember that parents were asked to attend a briefing session last year before they could help out."
[我記得去年家長在幫忙前要先參加 briefing session。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這是非常實用的 Task 3 內容，屬 how to get involved / responsibility 邊緣位：
● 家長不是隨便來就幫忙
● 要先參加 briefing
"Yes, perhaps we can have a similar arrangement this year. It was definitely useful for them to take part in."
[今年也許可以有類似安排，而那個 briefing 很有用。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句把 briefing 由去年的安排轉成今年很可能繼續採用的安排。
"I do remember, though, it was a bit difficult to get parents to sign up."
[不過我記得要令家長報名有點難。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句解釋了為何 Task 3 需要一封具說服力的 letter。 不是直接寫進信裡的內容，而是寫信背後原因。
"Actually, how should parents sign up? How should they show their interest in being involved?"
[那家長應如何報名？]
類型：5 提示
"They can sign up on the school website."
[他們可以在學校網站報名。]
類型：5 提示／錯誤線索
分析：
這句 馬上被更正，所以不能採用。 這是 DSE 很常見的陷阱：先講一個答案，再立刻被改正。
"No, through the school app."
[不是，是透過學校 app。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這才是最後正確答案。
Task 3 應寫：家長透過 school app 報名。
"Ah yes, of course. Through the app."
[對，透過 app。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
再次確認剛才的更正是 final version。
"How are we planning to get more parents involved this year, then?"
[那今年我們打算如何吸引更多家長參與？]
類型：5 提示
"We thought a letter from one of the students would be effective in persuading them, especially once they hear about all the benefits."
[我們覺得由一位學生寫信會較有效，尤其當家長知道所有好處之後。]
類型：3 Task 3 直接可用
分析：
這句很重要，因為它直接決定 Task 3 的寫作姿態：
● 由學生寫
● 目的在 persuasion
● 重點要寫 benefits
"Do you have someone in mind?"
[你想到由誰寫嗎？]
類型：5 提示
"I'm going to ask Nico Lin, president of the Healthy Living Club, to write the letter. Nico is also helping us out with a few other tasks related to the Wellness Month as well as the Asian Games Week."
[我打算請 Healthy Living Club 主席 Nico Lin 寫這封信。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句不是信件內容本身， 但它定了寫作者身份和立場。
"That sounds like good experience for Nico. Give Nico the recording of today's meeting. We've made quite a few decisions about these two events today."
[這對 Nico 會是好經驗，把今天錄音交給他吧，我們今日作了不少決定。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
再次強調：錄音包含更新版決定。
"I think we've covered everything we need to for now. Thank you both. Let's keep in touch as things progress. / Speak soon ... / See you later."
[會議結束。] 類型：6 無關噪音

title: 最後整合核心答案
text:
把所有資料整合成 Task 1、Task 2 和 Task 3 的最終可用內容及淘汰清單。
最後整合核心答案 上面所有頁面互相對讀後，得出的結論。
Task 1：校刊文章（宣傳 Wellness Month） 2025 主題
● Relax and Recover
三個會在 2025 再辦的活動 1. Crafting Session ○ 保留 ○ 但內容由去年的 South America 改為 Asian countries ○ 可強調 creativity 2. Wellness Fair ○ 保留 ○ 2025 會加入 interactive booths ○ 去年的 exercise advice 和 self-care resources 可保留 ○ good nutrition talk 不應再寫，因為營養師沒空 3. Yoga & Meditation Sessions ○ 保留 ○ 很配合 Relax and Recover ○ 新宣傳重點：improve focus and attention span ○ 可寫 two famous instructors ○ 但不可亂寫名字，因為未 confirmed
可用 student feedback
● chance to unwind after exams
● feel more prepared for next year's studies
● wide variety of meaningful activities
● everything was useful
● let creativity run loose
● picked up healthy habits
● exercise advice was helpful
應排除
● Sports Day at the Beach（未獲批，不入 Task 1）
● Fitness Challenge（已淘汰）
● Gardening & Plant Care（已淘汰）
● 2024 South America theme（已過時）
Task 2：proposal（爭取批准 Sports Day at the Beach） 為何提議這活動
● brand-new event
● more interesting
● more inclusive
● expose students to different cultures
● chance to spend quality time outdoors
● get students moving
選 sport 的標準
● students likely haven't tried them before
● physically challenging
● enjoyable for beginners
最應選的兩種 sport 1. Sepak Takraw ○ from Southeast Asia ○ easy for newcomers to pick up ○ great exercise ○ cultural element strong 2. Kabaddi ○ from India ○ fun ○ keeps players on the move ○ beginners can pick it up quickly ○ easy to explain (similar in some ways to Tag, but with breath-holding)
應淘汰的 sport
● Dragon Boat Racing：water sport / involves entering water / demanding
training
● Jianzi：students in Hong Kong already play it a lot / not new
● Wushu：takes years to learn basics
● Go：not active enough / players sit for long periods / not aligned with "get
students moving" 最可能的 beach venue
● 候選 originally：Stanley Main Beach / Cafeteria Beach / Cheung Sha Beach
● Stanley 被交通淘汰
● Cheung Sha 被泊車問題淘汰
● 所以剩下 Cafeteria Beach
Task 3：寫信給家長招募義工 Benefits
● volunteering is fun / enjoyable
● worthwhile
● parents can get to know other parents
● parents can get to know teachers
● parental involvement helps create a positive atmosphere
● students feel more relaxed during events
● students get to interact with adults beyond teachers
Responsibilities
● be present at their chosen event
● help students if needed
● take attendance / administration
● support events throughout the month
● not prepare students for events - that is the teachers' role
How to get involved
● sign up through the school app
● attend a briefing session before helping
寫作語氣
● 因為錄音明說 student-written letter would be effective
● 所以應是學生身份、真誠、有禮、鼓勵參與
● 要重 benefits，再講 responsibilities，再講 how to sign up

title: 分析方法、三項任務與 Situation
text:
You are Nico Lin. You are president of the Healthy Living Club and have been asked to help organise the Asian Games Week and Wellness Month at your school.
[你是 Nico Lin，是 Healthy Living Club 主席，並被要求協助籌辦 Asian Games Week 和 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這不是三篇作文的內容點。
● 你是學生
● 你有校內身份
● 三篇文都應以校內學生身份寫，不是老師、家長或記者身份

title: 分析方法、三項任務與 Situation
text:
You will listen to a recording of a meeting between Dr David Chan, your school's principal, Mr John Duncan, the school's vice principal, and Ms Melissa Henley, the head of PE.
[你將聆聽一段會議錄音，參與者是校長 David Chan、副校長 John Duncan 和 體育主任 Melissa Henley。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
說明錄音是正式資料來源，而且參與者都是後面文件中會反覆出現的人。 這代表錄音要和書面文件互相拼接。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
The Asian Games Week
[Asian Games Week]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
就這三個寫作任務來說，Asian Games Week 不是主線。 所以這整塊錄音大部分都是干擾。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
Slogan / Opening Event
[口號／開幕活動]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
都是 Asian Games Week 內容，不是 page 4 的三題。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
The Wellness Month
[Wellness Month]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是錄音裡真正有用的轉折位。
Task 1 和 Task 3 的關鍵補充，都會在這一段附近。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
Guest Speaker for the Asian Games Week / Speech topic / After the speech
[Asian Games Week 嘉賓講者／演講主題／演講後]
類型：6 無關噪音
分析：
這些全是 Asian Games Week 的子題，對三篇作文沒用。

title: Listening note-taking sheet
text:
Parent Involvement during the Wellness Month
[Wellness Month 期間的家長參與]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這一格 Task 3 非常重要

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
To: Nico Lin / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Ballater High School Wellness Month - Things to do / Sent: April 5 2025 09:02 AM
[收件人：Nico Lin／寄件人：John Duncan／主旨：Ballater High School Wellness Month - Things to do／時間：2025 年 4 月 5 日]
類型：5 提示
分析：
主旨已經定得很清楚： 這三個任務全部圍繞 Wellness Month。 所以錄音裡單純講 Asian Games Week 的內容應降權 Irrelevant

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Here are the tasks for you to do related to the Wellness Month.
[以下是你要處理、與 Wellness Month 有關的任務。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是整卷的總篩選句。 之後所有資料，都要看它能否服務這三個 Wellness Month 任務。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Can you draft an article for the school magazine to promote the Wellness Month?
[請草擬一篇校刊文章，宣傳 Wellness Month。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定 Task 1 的文類和目的：
● 文類：school magazine article
● 目的：promote
● 讀者：學生為主

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
The article should give the basic information about the three events from 2024 that we have already decided to include again.
[文章要介紹三個 2024 年的活動，而這三個已決定在 2025 再辦。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很重要，因為它定出 Task 1 的篩選原則：
● 不是所有 2024 活動都寫
● 只寫「已決定保留」的三個

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Make sure to include student feedback on the 2024 Wellness Month.
[記得加入 2024 Wellness Month 的學生意見。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是另一條硬規則：
Task 1 要用 student feedback。 所以 page 7 的學生發言最值錢；家長發言不應當成 Task 1 主體。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
You can refer to the emails between Ms Henley and I to begin with.
[可先參考我和 Ms Henley 的電郵。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接指路到第 5 頁。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
I also need you to draft a proposal about Ms Henley's idea for 'Sports Day at the Beach'.
[我還要你就 Melissa 的 'Sports Day at the Beach' 構思，草擬一份 proposal。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定出 Task 2 的文類：proposal。 這代表語氣要講理據，不是宣傳。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
This is a brand-new event that we want to include in the 2025 Wellness Month, but we need Dr Chan's approval first.
[這是一個想加入 2025 Wellness Month 的全新活動，但要先得到 Dr Chan 批 准。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句定出 Task 2 的真正功能： 不是介紹已定案活動，而是 爭取批准。 同時也解釋了為何 Task 1 不能把這個新活動寫進校刊文章。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Make sure you explain why we are proposing this new event, which two sports we've chosen with some basic information about them, and why we included these sports.
[記得解釋為何提議這個新活動、我們選了哪兩種運動、它們的基本資料，以 及為何選它們。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句完全定出 Task 2 的資料框架：
● 提議原因
● 兩種 sport
● sport 基本資料
● 選擇理由

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
I've included screenshots of a WhatsApp chat between Ms Henley and Dr Chan, which would be a good place to start.
[我附上 Melissa 和 Dr Chan 的 WhatsApp 對話截圖，那會是很好的起點。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
Task 2 首先看第 8 頁，但不會只靠第 8 頁。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Finally, write a letter to parents to ask for volunteers for the Wellness Month.
[最後，請寫一封信給家長，邀請他們成為 Wellness Month 義工。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
定出 Task 3。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
It's important that you highlight the benefits as well as outline the responsibilities they have when volunteering and how they can get involved.
[要強調好處，也要交代他們當義工的責任，以及如何參與。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句直接把 Task 3 拆成三部分：
● benefits
● responsibilities
● how to get involved

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
I was discussing this over email with Mr Singh from the School Events Team this morning.
[我今天早上曾和 School Events Team 的 Mr Singh 用電郵談過這件事。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
指路到第 9 頁。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
I've sent you this exchange to read.
[我已把那段往來寄給你。]
類型：5 提示

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Dr Chan has asked me to give you the recording of our meeting with Ms Henley.
[Dr Chan 叫我把我和 Ms Henley 的會議錄音交給你。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
錄音是正式資料來源，不是可有可無。

title: Email from Mr John Duncan to Nico Lin (boss letter)
text:
Have a listen to it: we made a few decisions about some of the above.
[你聽一聽：我們對上述一些事情作了決定。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很關鍵。 意思是：有些較早文件是舊版本，錄音有更新。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
To: Ms Melissa Henley / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: RE: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 11:27 AM
[收件人：Melissa／寄件人：John／主旨：RE: Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 11:27]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這是這串電郵裡最新一封，所以衝突時應以這封為準。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
OK, I agree with you about the Fitness Challenge and Gardening & Plant Care events.
[我同意你對 Fitness Challenge 和 Gardening & Plant Care 的看法。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這句單獨看仍不知道「同意甚麼」。 要回到 Melissa 上一封才知道，她的看法是 不要再辦 這兩個活動。 所以這句不是直接答案，而是需要跨句對讀的提示。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
Sports Day at the Beach? I'm intrigued!
[Sports Day at the Beach？我很有興趣！]
類型：5 提示
分析：
只是 John 的態度反應。 不是 proposal 內容。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
Check with Dr Chan first to get his approval.
[先問 Dr Chan，取得批准。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
再次確認 Task 2 的本質是爭取批准

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
It seems we now have three events that we can re-use from last year in this year's Wellness Month.
[看來我們現在已有三個去年活動，可以在今年再用。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句很重要，但它只說「三個」，沒列名字。 要再結合上下文拼出是哪三個。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I'll ask Nico to write about these in the school magazine.
[我會叫 Nico 把這些寫進校刊。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
直接把這組資料連到 Task 1。 但這句本身不是校刊內容。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I think it's best not to include the new event in the promotion for now, just in case Dr Chan doesn't approve.
[我覺得目前最好不要把新活動寫進宣傳，因為 Dr Chan 可能不批准。]
類型：5 提示／篩選線索
分析：
這句非常重要。 它清楚劃線：
Task 1 article 不應寫 Sports Day at the Beach。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
To: Mr John Duncan / From: Ms Melissa Henley / Subject: RE: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 10:45 AM
[收件人：John／寄件人：Melissa／主旨：RE: Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 10:45]
類型：5 提示

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I agree about the Crafting Session, but I would also suggest keeping the Wellness Fair.
[我同意保留 Crafting Session，同時我也建議保留 Wellness Fair。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句直接點出兩個保留活動：
● Crafting Session
● Wellness Fair

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
This was pretty popular last time and seemed useful to the students.
[這活動上次很受歡迎，而且對學生有用。]
類型：5 提示
分析：
這句是在解釋為何保留 Wellness Fair。 但它是老師判斷，不是 student feedback。 主要 所以可作保留理由，不宜當 Task 1 的 feedback。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I plan to include interactive booths this time around to make it even more interesting.
[我打算這次加入 interactive booths，令它更有趣。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這是 Wellness Fair 的 2025 新更新。 可以直接寫進校刊文章。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
The nutritionist who usually gives the talk has already told me that she's not available, so we'll have to cancel that, but otherwise the fair will include the same great features as last year.
[通常主講營養講座的營養師已表示她沒空，所以那部分要取消；但除此以外 ，fair 仍會保留去年的其他特色。]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用
分析：
這句很關鍵，因為它告訴你：
● 去年 poster 上的 good nutrition talk 今年不應再寫
● 其他去年 fair 特色仍可保留
所以之後 page 6 poster 要「有選擇地」取用

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
With regard to the Fitness Challenge and Gardening & Plant Care, let's not run these events again.
[至於 Fitness Challenge 和 Gardening & Plant Care，我們不要再辦了。]
類型：5 提示／淘汰線索
分析：
這句不是可以寫進 Task 1 的活動內容， 但它是最重要的淘汰句之一。 它直接把兩個活動剔除。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I've come up with a completely new event that I think would be much more interesting and inclusive: Sports Day at the Beach!
[我想出一個全新活動，我覺得它會更有趣、更具包容性： Sports Day at the Beach！]
類型：2 Task 2 直接可用
分析：
這句可以直接用作 proposal 的理由之一：
● more interesting
● more inclusive

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
To: Ms Melissa Henley / From: Mr John Duncan / Subject: Wellness Month events / Sent: March 24 2025 10:12 AM
[收件人：Melissa／寄件人：John／主旨：Wellness Month events／時間：3 月 24 日 10:12]
類型：5 提示

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
Let's decide on what the other events in the 2025 Wellness Month will be. Dr Chan already helped us choose one event in our meeting last week.
[讓我們決定 2025 Wellness Month 其餘活動。Dr Chan 上週會議已幫我們選定 其中一個活動。]

分析 - 這句說明：
● 在這串 email 開始之前，已經有 一個活動先被選定
● 這個活動最合理就是之後錄音 Podcast確認會再辦的
Yoga & Meditation Sessions
[ Dr Chan already helped us choose one event in our meeting last week."] 但這句本身沒有明講活動名稱，所以它是提示，不是直接答案。

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I've attached the poster we used for last year's Wellness Month, as a reminder of the events we held last time.
[我附上去年的 Wellness Month 海報，提醒我們去年有哪些活動。]

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I recommend having the Fitness Challenge again.

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
I also liked the Crafting Session, but this year, let's switch to Asian countries to make it more relevant to our students in Hong Kong.
[我也喜歡 Crafting Session，但今年改成以亞洲國家為主，更切合香港學生]

title: Emails between Mr John Duncan and Ms Melissa Henley
text:
What are your thoughts?
[你怎樣看？]

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024

Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024
[附件：2024 Wellness Month 海報]

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024

Wellness Month 2024
[2024 Wellness Month]

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024

Theme: The wonders of South America
[主題：南美洲奇觀] 過時線索
類型：5 提示／

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024
text:
Crafting Session
[手作活動]
類型：1 Task 1 直接可用

這個活動本身被保留。

title: Email attachment - poster for Wellness Month 2024
text:
Arts and crafts from South American countries
[來自南美洲國家的藝術與手作]

title: 逐句導讀補充

這是筆記位置指示。第 3 頁可協助辨認錄音主題；按分析，Wellness Month 及家長參與才是三項寫作的主線。

title: 逐句導讀補充

Recently, I’ve been hearing about Kabaddi.
引出 Kabaddi 的背景與玩法。後面的印度文化背景、不停移動和新手容易上手，才是支持選用 Kabaddi 的具體理由。

title: 逐句導讀補充
text:
Is this sport getting more popular?
這裡的 this sport 指上一句的 Dragon Boat Racing（龍舟），不是 Kabaddi。提問引出龍舟的吸引力，但即使受歡迎，仍要受『不批准下水活動』的限制。

title: 逐句導讀補充
text:
It is!
肯定上一個問題：龍舟越來越受歡迎。這只是專家回答的開頭；後文雖提到樂趣、運動量和友誼，龍舟仍因屬水上活動而不能入選。

title: 逐句導讀補充
text:
Originates from Ancient Chinese traditions and festivals.
補充龍舟的中國傳統文化背景。即使具有文化特色，龍舟仍是水上活動，違反第 10 頁『不會批准下水活動』的限制，不能選用。

In the history, briefly explain what inspired Ms Fong to found Shiny Diamond Lighting Ltd and give the company its name, then how she made her dream a reality and, finally, give an overview of the company’s growth and recognition since 1990. Ms Fong has been very kind in sending us extracts from her diary and a newspaper clipping to help with this, so start there.

Ms Fong has already written the introduction for the speech to help you get started.

text: Lucky Escape for Hong Kong Mountaineer Inspires a New Direction

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Kathmandu, 14th October 1980

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Hong Kong resident Pris Fong had a close call last week when climbing Manaslu mountain. Recovering after her rescue, the lucky lady said that her adventuring days may be over.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 香港居民 Pris Fong 上星期攀登馬納斯盧峰時險些喪命。獲救後正在康復的她表示，自己的冒險生涯或許已經結束。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Manaslu, meaning ‘mountain of the spirit’, is located in the Nepalese Himalayas. Standing at 8,163m above sea level, it is the eighth highest mountain in the world. First climbed in 1956, the mountain has developed a reputation as a place of great danger.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Manaslu 意為「精神之山」，位於尼泊爾喜馬拉雅山脈，海拔 8,163 米，是世界第八高峰。1956 年首次有人登頂，此山一直以極度危險聞名。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Injured during the climb, Ms Fong believes that the experience has given her the inspiration to start her own company, and even the company name.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Fong 女士在攀登期間受傷。她相信這段經歷啟發她創辦自己的公司，甚至帶來公司名字的靈感。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Ms Fong expressed deep gratitude to her rescuers. “Mountain climbing has been a real passion of mine for so long. I thank all the people who were involved in bringing me down from the mountain, and of course the wonderful medical staff who are taking care of me here in Kathmandu hospital.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Fong 女士向救援者深表謝意：「登山一直是我的熱愛。我感謝所有把我救下山的人，當然還有在加德滿都醫院照顧我的出色醫護人員。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: The weather forecast for the coming week on the mountain predicts stormy weather. Mountaineers are being warned to avoid the area for now.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 預測未來一星期山上將有暴風雨。當局提醒登山者暫時避開該區。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Tokyo 2020’s World Wow Web!

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: I looked up into the sky last night in Tokyo and saw something strange. Space invaders? Northern lights? Spirits taking flight?

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 昨夜我在東京仰望天空，看見奇異景象。是外星入侵者？北極光？還是飛翔的精靈？

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: None of the above. So, what was above me? Drones. Nearly 2000 of them, lighting up the night sky like a giant spider web as part of Tokyo’s incredible Olympic Games Opening Ceremony.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 以上都不是。頭上的是甚麼？無人機。接近 2,000 架，在東京精彩的奧運開幕禮中，像巨型蜘蛛網般照亮夜空。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: I felt extraordinarily lucky to witness the spectacle with Peter O’Rourke, the CEO of Flashbangs , Asia’s leading fireworks company. We were both stunned into silence by the magnificent drone display.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 我非常幸運，能與亞洲頂尖煙花公司 Flashbangs 的行政總裁 Peter O’Rourke 一同目睹盛況。我們都被壯觀的無人機表演震撼得說不出話來。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Mr O’Rourke is a leading expert on outdoor lighting displays. I couldn’t resist asking him if what we were seeing represented the future of this industry.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: O’Rourke 先生是戶外燈光表演的頂尖專家。我忍不住問他，眼前所見是否代表這個行業的未來。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: His reply? “I don’t think so.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Oh really, Mr O’Rourke? That didn’t seem likely.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “You try programming thousands of drones to perform at once!” he snapped. I was worried I’d overstepped the mark… “It’s complicated.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 他沒好氣地說：「你試試為幾千架無人機編程，讓它們同時表演！」我擔心自己問得太過分……「這很複雜。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: And expensive, too? He nodded in agreement. It seems traditional lighting displays are safe from drones for now.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 而且也很昂貴？他點頭同意。看來傳統燈光表演暫時不會被無人機取代。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: We made up over a sushi buffet and some very, very nice sencha tea.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 我們吃了壽司自助餐，喝了非常非常好喝的煎茶，於是和好了。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Extracts from Pris Fong’s Diary

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Lucky escape on the mountain last night. I’m in agony! Not sure how I will get down. Camping here overnight, but it’s freezing. All we have is sour tea and a small fire to keep warm. I hope this won’t be my last diary entry.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 昨夜在山上僥倖逃生。我痛得不得了！不知道怎樣下山。今晚在這裏露營，但冷極了。我們只有酸茶和一小堆火取暖。希望這不是我最後一篇日記。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: One of the longest days of my life! Never felt so much pain for so long, but we made it down. I am indebted to my guide for carrying me. What an incredible woman she is! A true hero. She risked her life to save me when I thought all hope was lost. I’m truly grateful just to be alive.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 這是我人生中最漫長的一天之一！從未試過痛這麼久，但我們終於下山了。我十分感激背着我的嚮導。她真了不起！是真正的英雄。我以為再無希望時，她冒着生命危險救我。能活着已令我非常感恩。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Flown to Kathmandu hospital by helicopter today. Incredible view of Manaslu as we left. Made this sketch of what the icy peak looked like in the sun. Unforgettable!

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 今天乘直升機到加德滿都醫院。離開時馬納斯盧峰的景色美得驚人。我畫了這幅素描，記下冰峰在陽光下的樣子。難以忘懷！

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Doctors confirmed today the ankle is badly sprained. Believe it or not, I feel lucky that’s all! I’ll be off my feet for a while, the doctors say. I’ve been thinking a lot about my future these few days. More of that as I recover, I suppose.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 醫生今天確認腳踝嚴重扭傷。信不信由你，我慶幸只是這樣！醫生說我有一段時間不能走動。這幾天我一直思考自己的未來。康復期間應該還會再想吧。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: I can’t wait to get home to Hong Kong and see everyone, of course, but after that I’m going to see what it takes to live my dream and start my own company – making neon lights! And the company name? I think my sketch says it all!

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 我當然迫不及待想回香港見大家，之後我要研究怎樣實現夢想，開設自己的公司，製造霓虹燈！公司名字呢？我想那幅素描已說明一切！

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Made it back to Hong Kong! Time to take the first (gentle!) step on my new ‘adventure’. First things first: I need to get some training. Let’s see if I can do this. The journey starts today!

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 終於回到香港！是時候踏出新「冒險」的第一步，輕輕地踏！首先我要接受一些訓練。看看我能否做到。旅程今天開始！

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: We are a group of concerned residents who live in Wan Yuen Estate. We are aware that Fortune Phoenix Towers intends to have your company install an outdoor lighting display measuring 50 metres by 300 metres. Plans that we have acquired also show a rotating cube on top of Fortune Phoenix Towers that will project images.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 我們是一群居於 Wan Yuen Estate、關注社區的居民。我們得悉 Fortune Phoenix Towers 打算委託貴公司安裝一個 50 米乘 300 米的戶外燈光裝置。我們取得的圖則亦顯示，大廈頂部會設置一個可投影的旋轉立方體。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: As residents we hold two major concerns. The first is light pollution. Surely such a large display at night will make the night become day to any apartment that faces Fortune Phoenix Towers.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 身為居民，我們有兩項主要關注。第一是光污染。如此巨大的裝置在夜間發光，必然令所有面向 Fortune Phoenix Towers 的住宅日夜不分。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Our second concern is about the safety of the rotating cube. We refer to the incident where a similar moving display on a building collapsed and destroyed a car in 2015. We have attached the relevant news story to jog your memory.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 第二是旋轉立方體的安全問題。我們指的是 2015 年一座大廈的類似活動裝置倒塌、壓毀汽車的事故。我們附上相關新聞，讓貴公司重溫事件。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: We look forward to a prompt response to our very serious concerns.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Yours faithfully, Mr Chan Kat Yi, Eric Chairperson, Wan Yuen Estate Residents’ Association

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Harold Tsang got the shock of his life last Wednesday morning when he found his car crushed under a 5-metre-high lighting display.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 上星期三早上，Harold Tsang 發現自己的汽車被一個 5 米高的燈光裝置壓着，嚇得魂飛魄散。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “I saw this flash outside my window, then heard a terrific bang and wallop. I looked out the window and saw my car totally smashed up with a huge sign sticking out its roof,” said Mr Tsang.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Tsang 先生說：「我看見窗外閃了一下，然後聽見巨大的爆響和撞擊聲。我望出窗外，看見自己的車完全被砸爛，一塊巨型招牌插穿了車頂。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: The display, which ironically advertised accident insurance, had come loose and broke off the North Dragon Gardens rooftop. No one was hurt.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 諷刺的是，這個宣傳意外保險的裝置鬆脫，從 North Dragon Gardens 天台掉下。無人受傷。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Rick Lai, on behalf of Shiny Diamond Lighting Ltd - the company which installed the display, stated that the early theory about the accident was that it was due to poor maintenance.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 安裝裝置的 Shiny Diamond Lighting Ltd 代表 Rick Lai 表示，初步推測事故由保養欠佳引起。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Eddie Bong, the leader of an independent team of engineers investigating the incident, later confirmed this, stating that the original installation had passed all safety checks.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 負責調查的獨立工程師團隊主管 Eddie Bong 其後證實此說法，並表示最初安裝時已通過所有安全檢查。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “We’re all lucky that no one was hurt,” said local resident Carol Bodega. “Anyone could have been crushed under the display. Terrible!”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 居民 Carol Bodega 說：「沒有人受傷，大家都很幸運。任何人都有可能被裝置壓着，太可怕了！」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: North Dragon Gardens building management declined to give any comment.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: North Dragon Gardens 的大廈管理方拒絕置評。

text: 出席： Pris Fong 女士 Bati Khatoon 先生（安裝團隊主管） Rick Lai 先生（首席設計師） Floyd Mann 先生（總經理）

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Item 1 – Response to the Wan Yuen Estate Residents’ Association

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 議程一：回覆 Wan Yuen Estate 居民協會

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Ms Fong asked Mr Khatoon whether the concerns expressed about the Fortune Phoenix Towers display by the Wan Yuen Estate Residents’ Association had any merit.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Fong 女士詢問 Khatoon 先生，居民協會對 Fortune Phoenix Towers 燈光裝置的擔憂是否有道理。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Mr Khatoon pointed out that Shiny Diamond seemed to have been unfairly blamed for something which was not our fault and, quite frankly, out of our control. He asked if the Association had not realised that by law all outdoor lighting displays had to be dimmed by the building’s management by 11pm, among other relevant regulations.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Khatoon 先生指出，Shiny Diamond 似乎因一些並非己方過失、坦白說亦無法控制的事情而遭到不公平指責。他質疑協會是否不知道，法例要求大廈管理方最遲在晚上 11 時調暗所有戶外燈光裝置，此外尚有其他相關規定。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Mr Lai said that since the incident Shiny Diamond now worked closely with each building’s management office to ensure regular maintenance was carried out.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Lai 先生表示，自該事故後，Shiny Diamond 與各大廈管理處緊密合作，確保定期進行保養。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Ms Fong suggested that these two facts should be highlighted in any response, and that Shiny Diamond should offer to meet members of the Wan Yuen Estate Residents’ Association. She insisted that it be stressed that the company cared deeply about residents living near our lighting displays. She also recommended avoiding Mr Khatoon’s language about “fault” and “blame”.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Fong 女士建議在回覆中強調這兩點，並主動提出與居民協會成員會面。她要求強調公司非常關心居於燈光裝置附近的居民，也建議避免使用 Khatoon 先生提及「過失」和「責怪」的措辭。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Item 2 – The commercial use of drone displays

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Ms Fong stated that it was important for Shiny Diamond to consider offering drone displays as an alternative to neon. She distributed printed copies of the Emily Plays travel blog for the Committee’s consideration.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Fong 女士表示，Shiny Diamond 應考慮提供無人機表演，作為霓虹燈以外的選擇。她派發《Emily Plays》旅遊網誌的列印本，供委員會考慮。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Mr Lai agreed with the overall message of the blog, although the display had been impressive.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Lai 先生雖然認為表演令人印象深刻，但同意網誌的整體看法。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Mr Khatoon expressed further concerns over drones’ safety issues that meant their use would be limited. When asked, he clarified that they required good weather conditions. Finally, he advised Committee members to view the most recent Customer Survey, which demonstrated the nature of neon lights’ lasting appeal. This should therefore be the continuing focus of the company.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Khatoon 先生亦關注無人機的安全問題，認為這會限制其用途。被追問時，他解釋無人機需要良好的天氣條件。最後，他建議委員參閱最新顧客調查，了解霓虹燈歷久不衰的吸引力。因此，公司應繼續以霓虹燈為重點。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Ms Fong agreed and brought the meeting to a close.

text: Instructors’ feedback from last year’s Planet Tarkov Problem-Solving Activity

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “Please, please, please can we simplify the situation? Rather than all that complicated stuff about heading to a new colony on LV-426 and being hit by a comet, let’s just start by telling them they crashed on Tarkov. Also make the objective of the activity much much clearer. So, forget about the repairs. It would be much better, in my opinion, if they needed to survive for a year until they were rescued.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 「拜託，拜託，能簡化情境嗎？不要再講前往 LV-426 新殖民地及被彗星撞擊的複雜背景，一開始就說他們在塔爾科夫星墜毀吧。活動目標也要清楚得多。因此別再講維修；我認為改為要生存一年等待救援會好得多。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: These all seem sensible. I would agree to adopt all of these.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “Fun to teach and most kids enjoyed it, but TBH there were a lot of kids not doing anything. We have to reduce the group size down from ten – I’d say to 5 – and give the children more than just 30 mins. to solve the problem. How about 2 hours overall – one hour to solve the problem, one hour for the groups to present to the other groups? I would also say that we should increase the amount of Physics. Make it like a real Science class so that the kids can learn something useful instead of just chatting.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 「教起來很有趣，多數小朋友也喜歡，但坦白說很多孩子甚麼也沒做。我們必須把每組十人減少，我建議五人，並給他們多於三十分鐘解難。不如總共兩小時：一小時解難，一小時讓各組向其他組匯報？我也建議增加物理內容，像真正科學課，讓孩子學些有用的東西，而不是只聊天。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Agree to adopt her suggestions regarding group size and time. Totally disagree with the point about Science. This is NOT school.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 同意採納她對組別人數及時間的建議。完全不同意科學方面的意見。這裏不是學校。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “Went well more or less. But could you make a 3D model of Tarkov and the spaceship so that kids can see it? I like the fact that they arrive on Tarkov in spring – this makes good sense, since it would give the crew time to actually do something before the weather turns extreme. I found a lot of interesting stuff on Tarkov and the science behind why the weather is so extreme on the NASA webpage. It really is fascinating. I think it would be good to add to the introduction.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 「大致順利。但可否製作塔爾科夫星及太空船的立體模型，讓孩子看看？我喜歡他們在春季抵達的設定，很合理，讓船員在天氣變得極端前有時間行動。我在 NASA 網頁找到很多關於塔爾科夫星及極端天氣成因的有趣科學資料，非常吸引。我覺得可加入介紹。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: The 3D model is a good idea but we have no budget. So no. And, again, no, I do not want to turn this into a Science class.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 立體模型的主意不錯，但沒有預算，所以不採納。再說一次，不，我不想把活動變成科學課。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: “Need to get across just how extreme summer and winter on Tarkov are. Some kids don’t know how hot it is. One group even thought that all they would need is more shorts and T-shirts in Tarkov’s summer!!! Surely, we can add some exciting facts about the winter and summer.”

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 「必須講清楚塔爾科夫星夏冬兩季有多極端。有些孩子不知道有多熱，甚至有一組以為夏天只需多些短褲和 T 恤！我們應加入一些關於冬夏兩季的刺激事實。」

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Yes, agree. We can ask the astronomer Marvin Adams. He knows lots of amazing stuff about Tarkov.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 同意。我們可以問天文學家 Marvin Adams，他知道很多關於塔爾科夫星的奇妙知識。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Why I say Gamezstart ‘stinks’

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Welcome back to my blog. This week I want to talk about getting funds for your board game.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: You’ve developed a board game and the next step is to sell it but you probably don’t have the cash to pay for a factory to produce it. So one way you can solve the problem is Gamezstart (www.gamezstart.com). And what’s so good about Gamezstart? Well, one huge plus without a doubt is that you get to advertise your game on their website. This attracts investors to invest in your game. The clever part is that you set the target amount of money you need to produce the game. It gives you ultimate flexibility! Sounds great eh? People invest and you get the money to continue developing your game. Problem solved! And when it’s finished you send one copy of the game to each investor. So everybody’s happy. It’s a win-win situation, right? Wrong!

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 你已開發桌遊，下一步是出售，但可能沒有錢找工廠生產。Gamezstart（www.gamezstart.com）是其中一個解決方法。它有甚麼好？一大優點是可以在其網站宣傳遊戲，吸引投資者。巧妙之處是你能自行設定生產遊戲所需的目標金額，極具彈性！聽來很棒吧？大家投資，你取得資金繼續開發，問題解決！完成後每位投資者獲寄一盒遊戲，皆大歡喜。雙贏，對吧？錯！

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Big companies who are already well-known, and who have already published a bunch of stuff, are now using Gamezstart to advertise their latest products. And if you have a Gamezstart project at the same time as another project, one from a big company, then your project is very likely gonna be ignored by investors. You’ll be a tiny fish competing with a great big shark.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 那些本已知名、推出過許多產品的大公司，如今也用Gamezstart宣傳新品。如果你的項目與大公司的項目同時推出，投資者很可能忽略你，就像小魚與大鯊魚競爭。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: And that’s why I say Gamezstart ‘stinks’ for non-professionals like you and me.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 所以我說，對你我這些非專業人士，Gamezstart「很爛」。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: Golden Dragon Tail Butterfly

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: This butterfly is quite common in Asia but exists in only a very few areas of South China. It is the only known species in South China that pollinates the extremely rare Splash of Gold Orchid. This rare and beautiful plant can now only be found on Golden Flower Island. Only half of this island has been designated by the HKSAR Government as a nature park due to it being an area of special scientific interest. Development is therefore only restricted in that part of the island. Trouble may be brewing, however, as the local press has reported that development plans are afoot for the island for 2017. Let’s hope common sense prevails and we can protect these beautiful plants and creatures.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 這種蝴蝶在亞洲頗常見，但在華南只見於極少數地區。它是華南唯一已知能為極罕見的Splash of Gold Orchid授粉的物種。這種稀有美麗的蘭花現時只見於Golden Flower Island。香港特區政府因其具特殊科學價值，只把島嶼的一半劃為自然公園，因此只有那部分限制發展。不過危機可能正醞釀：本地報章指出，島上正籌備2017年的發展計劃。希望大家能作明智決定，保護這些美麗的動植物。

text: Yes, I heard that a query had been raised on the Business Matters radio show. The solution at the Highland Adventure Centre was quite costly at the time and the centre was closed for six months. Substantial reconstruction work was carried out reducing the waterfall from 45 to 30 metres. At that height, the clouds did not form as they had previously. Since the reopening of the centre, no similar problems have occurred.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: 我聽說有人在《Business Matters》提出疑問。當年Highland Adventure Centre的解決方案成本頗高，中心關閉了六個月。大規模改建把瀑布由45米降至30米；在這個高度，不再像以前般形成雲霧。中心重開後沒有再發生類似問題。

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
text: By the way, I didn’t get round to sending Gehry my recommendations, as I wanted to hear what everybody else was suggesting first. From our team’s perspective, all the features proposed in Manu Architects’ initial concept plan and in our staff’s suggestions are definitely all practical. Nothing that we haven’t done before.

title: Data File / 原題目及練習

title: Data File / 原題目及練習
